Experimental [REST API](https://useapi.net/docs/api-faceswap-v1) for [InsightFaceSwap Discord Bot](https://discord.gg/Ym3X8U59ZN) by [Picsi.Ai](https://www.picsi.ai/). InsightFaceSwap allows users to swap faces from source image(s) onto different target images. It offers free and paid [subscription](https://www.patreon.com/picsi) models. Paid subscribers have access to a wide selection of extra features such as [HiFidelity Mode](https://www.patreon.com/posts/89036144), [ARTIFY](https://www.patreon.com/posts/picsi-ai-v2-0-97389077), oldify/youngify, morphing multiple faces in one image, and [many more](https://discord.com/channels/1095014106576212101/1128550062683865178). The experimental InsightFaceSwap API does not require any additional subscription, and we believe it will complement our other experimental API offerings well. Following InsightFaceSwap Discord Bot commands supported: - [GET faceswap/account](https://useapi.net/docs/api-faceswap-v1/get-faceswap-account.html) - [GET faceswap/account/channel](https://useapi.net/docs/api-faceswap-v1/get-faceswap-account-channel.html) - [POST faceswap/account/channel](https://useapi.net/docs/api-faceswap-v1/post-faceswap-account-channel.html) - [DEL faceswap/account/channel](https://useapi.net/docs/api-faceswap-v1/del-faceswap-account-channel.html) - [POST faceswap/listid](https://useapi.net/docs/api-faceswap-v1/post-faceswap-listid.html) - [POST faceswap/saveid](https://useapi.net/docs/api-faceswap-v1/post-faceswap-saveid.html) - [POST faceswap/swapid](https://useapi.net/docs/api-faceswap-v1/post-faceswap-swapid.html) - [POST faceswap/swap](https://useapi.net/docs/api-faceswap-v1/post-faceswap-swap.html) - [POST faceswap/inswapper](https://useapi.net/docs/api-faceswap-v1/post-faceswap-inswapper.html) - [POST faceswap/setid](https://useapi.net/docs/api-faceswap-v1/post-faceswap-setid.html) - [DEL faceswap/delid](https://useapi.net/docs/api-faceswap-v1/del-faceswap-delid.html) - [DEL faceswap/delall](https://useapi.net/docs/api-faceswap-v1/post-faceswap-delall.html) We fully support the ability to use [multiple InsightFaceSwap accounts](https://useapi.net/docs/api-faceswap-v1/setup-multiple-faceswap-accounts), complete with automated load balancing. Visit [https://useapi.net](https://useapi.net) for more details. --- **Updated:** January 20, 2026 Contact Support: Name: useapi.net support Email: support@useapi.net
